# Xodus Nexus 0.2.3

- Install verified launcher updates directly from Settings, with restart and rollback to the previous AppImage.
- Show available launcher updates in the top-right corner.
- Select the newest published Nexus runtime even when GitHub lists an older build first.
- Check installed game versions and mark available updates in My Library.
- Open diagnostic logs inside the launcher instead of relying on system file associations.
- Fix download progress parsing, including split terminal output and per-file counters; install the required terminal utilities automatically.
- Improve game shutdown and Stop controls so launch helpers do not leave games marked as running.
- Remove the duplicate Install Queue entry and refresh the demo screenshots.

**Recommended:** update Nexus runtime in Settings as well. The new runtime includes shared sign-in, cloud-save and shutdown fixes that may improve many games.
